subject: Electrical Engineering
title: DC Generators: Rectified Rotation
description: One-minute skill: DC Generators: Rectified Rotation.

hook.text: A DC generator is nearly identical to a DC motor — spin it mechanically and DC comes out.

buildup.text: The commutator rectifies the naturally alternating EMF into pulsating DC.

discovery.text: Multiple armature coils smooth the output. More coils mean less ripple.

twist.text: Modern DC generation usually uses an AC generator with electronic rectifiers instead.

climax.text: Early power stations used DC generators — Edison's Pearl Street Station in 1882.

punchline.text: Spin a coil, flip the output — the commutator turns AC into DC mechanically.

quiz.question: How does a DC generator produce direct current?
options: Its coils only generate current in one direction
A commutator mechanically rectifies the alternating EMF into pulsating DC
Permanent magnets on the rotor create a constant DC field
